notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
So now when you start a stage the ball will not move until you press a button so now you will have more control of the ball at the start of each stage.

Added a level select so you no longer need a password.  for every 5 levels you complete will unlock a stage if you get a game over so you wont have to start from level 1, but your score will be reset

notes.title: Bug Fix 9/19
notes.notes: Fixed the bug when you click on the high score button on the main menu it takes you to view high scores but also asks for you to input you name when you have no score

notes.title: Release!!!
notes.notes: The game is finished!  now we just wait for it to be approved and then you all can get the game!
